# Arké

> Arké is an experimental, self-custodial bitcoin wallet for iPhone, focused on instant, low-fee payments. It is built on the Ark protocol and is open source. It runs on bitcoin mainnet and is available through TestFlight.

The pages under "About the wallet" and "Optional" link to plain Markdown copies. Drop the `.md` for the HTML page. The test guide continues at `/test-1.md` to `/test-9.md`.

## Screens

- [Screen gallery](https://www.arke.cash/screens): Screens from Arké's development builds, grouped by flow (first use, restore, home, balances and refresh, receive, send, contacts, settings, deleting a wallet), each with a caption and capture date. Most were captured on signet.
- [Screen index (JSON)](https://www.arke.cash/screens.json): The same screens as data: flow, caption, state, network, whether the screen is Ark-specific, capture date and image URL. Screenshots are licensed CC BY-NC 4.0.

## About the wallet

- [How Arké works](https://www.arke.cash/how.md): A bitcoin wallet focused on instant, low-fee payments.
- [How Arké works, technically](https://www.arke.cash/how-technical.md): Architecture, trust model, key management, and tradeoffs for the Ark protocol implementation in Arké.
- [What is Ark?](https://www.arke.cash/ark.md): What the Ark protocol is and why it matters.
- [Design](https://www.arke.cash/design.md): The design philosophy and creative direction behind Arké.
- [FAQ](https://www.arke.cash/faq.md): Answers to common questions about Arké.
